name: AgentSlackDispatch
description: Retrieval eval worker (agent, Slack transport): runs ONE case through the REAL Slack path against FirstClassDarwin. Posts turns as Rob @mentioning the agent, polls the thread for the bot reply (no reaction signal on the agent platform), captures tool call

nodeGroups.name: Slack transport
nodeGroups.description: Posts each case turn as Rob mentioning the agent; polls the thread until the bot replies (replaces the old reaction signal)

nodeGroups.name: Capture and score
nodeGroups.description: Reads the answer from the thread, matches tool sub-workflow executions by parentAgentRun.threadId, scores with the standard retrieval scorer
